title: Miband 4 - Feature Request: European Formatted Date
symptom: The date on the Mi Band 4 watchface is displayed in US format (e.g., 5/19), which can be confusing for users accustomed to European format (e.g., 19.5). The user requests an option to show the date in European format.
fix: The issue was resolved by adding new watchface bin files with European date format and a switch in the option menu, as part of the new Miband integration beta version 0.3 (25.08.2020).
evidence_quote: Now part of the new Miband integration beta [ver 0.3 (25.08.2020)].
